messages:
Alex Chen: Morning everyone, Alex starting today on Platform Eng. Quick cloud access ask — I need access to GCP project `redwood-dev-eu-01` (create if needed) with roles to create service accounts and push infra: roles/viewer, roles/iam.serviceAccountUser, roles/storage.objectAdmin. Also need permission to deploy to eu-west1.

Alex Chen: On AWS I need to assume the dev role in the apac account (`arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/Redwood-Dev-APAC`) and S3 read/write for `redwood-dev-artifacts` bucket. Who's the right person to get the billing link hooked up for the GCP project (EU billing)? :wave:

Infra Onboarding Bot: Thanks @Alex Chen — created request ticket #ONB-7842 for cloud access. Please post the completed request template here and an infra engineer will triage.

Maria Gomez: hey Alex, welcome! :tada: Copy/paste this minimal template and fill the fields, then we'll route: 

```
Requestor: <Full name> (<email>)
Project ID or requested name: <project-id>
Environment: dev/stage/prod
GCP roles needed: <comma separated>
GCP regions: <regions>
AWS account/role ARN (if needed): <arn>
AWS permissions needed: <e.g., s3:GetObject,s3:PutObject>
Billing account preference / cost center: <billing id / cost center>
Justification: <why you need access>
```

Maria Gomez: Also you can open the form at https://redwood.internal/onboarding/cloud-access but posting here is fine for small requests. For billing linkage we usually need finance approval (cost center).

Devon Patel: hey Alex — I can help with the AWS assume-role part. The role you want is `arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/Redwood-Dev-APAC` and you can assume it with the CLI: 

```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn "arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/Redwood-Dev-APAC" --role-session-name alex-session
# then set the creds from the output
```

Devon Patel: fyi you'll need MFA enforcement depending on your account; if you hit perms error ping me and I'll escalate. Also confirm which S3 bucket prefix you need write access to.

Samir Kapoor: Billing note — to link a new GCP project to the EU billing account we need: (1) project created, (2) billing account id `BILL-EU-09A1`, (3) cost center code and PO number if applicable. Finance needs an approval email thread. If you give me the cost center I can start the finance side.

Alex Chen: filling in the template now — thanks. Quick answers: 
Requestor: Alex Chen (alex.chen@redwood.ai)
Project ID or requested name: redwood-dev-eu-01
Environment: dev
GCP roles needed: roles/viewer, roles/iam.serviceAccountUser, roles/storage.objectAdmin
GCP regions: europe-west1 (eu-west1)
AWS account/role ARN (if needed): arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/Redwood-Dev-APAC
AWS permissions needed: s3:GetObject,s3:PutObject,s3:ListBucket
Billing account preference / cost center: BILL-EU-09A1 / COST-PLATFORM-DEV
Justification: onboarding + infra tests for runtime integration.

Alex Chen: also can someone create a short-lived service account for CI testing or tell me if I should create one? :slightly_smiling_face:

Maria Gomez: perfect, thanks. I'll add this to ONB-7842 and ping infra. Samir — can you start the finance approval for BILL-EU-09A1 + COST-PLATFORM-DEV?

Samir Kapoor: on it, looping finance now. Expect an approval email by EOD. :thumbsup:

Infra Onboarding Bot: ONB-7842 updated: assigned to @Cloud Platform. Estimated completion: 1 business day (may take longer for billing approvals).

Cloud Platform: got it — we'll provision the GCP roles and confirm when project is linked. Devon, I'll coordinate the AWS role trust policy if Alex needs cross-account sts setup.

Alex Chen: awesome, thank you all! If anything blocks me I’ll reply here.
